method.weights: equal (n_i = N for every class of the per-card catalog; E_i = 1, t_i = T)
formulas: pt_i* = (1 − A* − Σ non-domain pauses) · n_i / Σ n
λ_i* = pt_i* · 3600 / (A* · p̄_i)  [per hour, p̄_i = mean pause per event of the class under the mechanism set]
k_i = λ_i / λ_i*  (> 1: the class must improve; < 1: slack)
reallocation: under-budget classes keep their current points; the remaining budget is split over the over-budget classes by the same weights → k_i′
selection: add the mechanism with the largest Σ_i∈over max(0, pt_i − max(pt_i^new, pt_i*)) − Δfixed per unit effort until A_op ≥ A* nominally and derated
